description: This file defines a Smarty plugin for the 'upper' modifier, used to convert strings to uppercase. It contains a function that returns the appropriate PHP code to perform the case conversion, using either multibyte string functions or the standard strtoupper function as a fallback.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_upper
methods.description: Function that generates PHP code to convert a string to uppercase, utilizing multibyte string functions if available, otherwise falling back to strtoupper.
